about: Reference outages used to validate the detector against IODA's published analysis. 'published' holds what IODA reported, as cited in the Subteam 2 Week 5 deck (sources A1, I1) or in our Nov 12 2026 journalist brief. 'checks' are what the detector must reproduce from raw API data.

published.claim: First connectivity drop around 11:00 UTC on Sep 29
Sustained nationwide drop around 12:30 UTC (article intro says 12:30 a.m.; later timeline says 12:30 PM UTC)
Traffic restored around 11:45 UTC on Oct 1

cases.title: Iran international shutdown and staged recovery

published.claim: Shutdown at 20:00 Iran time = 16:30 UTC on Jan 8
Telescope near zero by 18:45 UTC Jan 8
Telescope shows renewed traffic Jan 24; Active Probing recovers sharply Jan 27
Google traffic fell for 12 h from 17:30 UTC Oct 27; BGP dropped for 21 h from 17:50 UTC
published.source: IODA events via our Nov 12 2026 journalist brief

cases.title: Negative control: platform-wide probing glitch (189 countries at 00:00 UTC Oct 18)

published.claim: 189 countries showed a 1-hour probing event starting at the same minute
published.source: IODA events API, our Nov 12 2026 analysis

checks.expect: the glitch is flagged suspected-artifact and no candidate is presented as a corroborated outage

published.claim: Probing daily median fell to 51% on Oct 18 and 76% on Oct 19; routing unaffected
published.source: IODA raw signals via our Nov 12 2026 journalist brief
